The task is to fill out a JSON object with specific fields comparing the goal-directed fluid therapy (GDFT) arm and the control arm. Let me go through the article step by step to find all the necessary information.

First, I'll check the study design and participants section. The article mentions it's a double-blinded, single-center randomized trial involving 283 patients, with 142 in the GDFT arm and 141 in the control arm. So, n_randomized_gdft is 142, and n_randomized_control is 141.

The surgery type is open radical cystectomy since the study was limited to patients undergoing open surgery. The laparoscopy_gdft and laparoscopy_control should both be 0 because the study didn't involve laparoscopic procedures.

Looking at ASA scores, the article states that 70% of the population had an ASA score of 3–4. Since the data is similar across both arms, I'll note that the ASA distribution is 30% ASA II and 70% ASA III-IV for both GDFT and control.

For total fluid, the GDFT arm had a lower total fluid output median of 13,380 mL, while the control had 15,445 mL. Crystalloid intake was 2,892 mL for GDFT and 5,580 mL for control. Colloid intake was 1,000 mL for GDFT and 975 mL for control.

Blood loss was similar in both arms, with GDFT at 400 mL and control at 450 mL.

Inotrope use was comparable, with 100% of both arms using them.

Morbidity events: 96% in GDFT and 89% in control had at least one complication. Mortality was 0.7% for both arms.

Hospital LOS was 7 days for both, but with slight interquartile ranges.

Postoperative ileus occurred in 25% of GDFT and 21% of control.

I'll structure all this information into the JSON format, ensuring each field is correctly cited with the section of the article it was taken from. I'll make sure to mark any missing data as NR, but in this case, all required fields are present.
